title: Your setback is the setup

scenes.say: Your setback is not the end of you.
scenes.visual: a man sitting alone on concrete steps at dawn, head down, empty city street behind him

scenes.say: It is the setup for what comes next.
scenes.visual: close up of hands lacing worn work boots tight, low morning light

scenes.say: Every hard season is teaching you something.
scenes.visual: rain running down a window at night, blurred street lights outside

scenes.say: So stop asking why this happened to you.
scenes.visual: a man looking at his own reflection in a dark window, serious face in shadow

scenes.say: Start asking what it is building in you.
scenes.visual: a man doing push ups on a bare apartment floor, sunrise through the blinds

scenes.say: Then get up and take one step today.
scenes.visual: a man walking up a long outdoor staircase toward bright morning sun, seen from behind

scenes.say: Follow for more. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: sun breaking over a city skyline, golden light across rooftops

caption: Your setback is not the end. It is the setup.
